title: SURFIX D
subtitle: Concrete Surface Densifier
desc: Proprietary blend of silicates formulated specifically for concrete surface densifiers and hardeners for new and old concrete floors.
highlight: Lithium Base Densifier & Hardener Sealer for Old & Non-Concrete

techData.dryTime: Touch: 1-2 hrs • Foot traffic: 12 hrs • Full cure: 24-48 hrs
techData.applicationMethod: Low pressure spray, microfiber mop, or soft broom
techData.thinning: Ready to use. Do not dilute with water
techData.uses: Industrial warehouses, commercial floorings, manufacturing facilities, parking structures, and non-concrete mineral surfaces.

features:
• Deep lithium silicate penetration chemically hardens concrete
• Densifies concrete matrix to eliminate surface dust and chalking
• Permanent chemical reaction cannot peel, chip, or flake
• Resistant to forklift tire marks and light chemical spills
appSchedule:
1. Ensure concrete is thoroughly clean, dry, and sound.
2. Apply Surfix D uniformly using a low-pressure sprayer at 6-10 m²/L.
3. Keep surface wet with material for 20-30 minutes using a microfiber mop.
4. Squeegee away any excess puddling. Allow 12 hours drying.
surfacePrep: Concrete floor must be clean, free from sealers, curing membranes, oils, grease, and loose debris.
materialPrep: Single component, ready to use directly from container. Stir lightly before use.

title: SURFIX DP
subtitle: Liquid Dust Proofer and Hardener for Concrete
desc: Single-pack concrete surface dust proofer and hardener based on sodium silicate that reacts chemically to produce a hard, dust-free finish.
highlight: Sodium Silicate Base Densifier & Dustproofer for Light Dusting Concrete

techData.dryTime: Initial reaction: 2-3 hrs • Complete cure: 24 hrs
techData.uses: New and aged concrete floors with light dusting, garage floors, basement slabs, and storage rooms.

features:
• Binds free lime and calcium carbonate into tough silicate crystals
• Prevents concrete surface dusting under foot and light wheeled traffic
• Economical dust-proofing solution for large floor expanses
• Non-flammable, odorless, and eco-friendly
appSchedule:
1. Clean and vacuum concrete floor thoroughly.
2. Apply Surfix DP evenly over the slab.
3. Work into pores with a soft broom for 15-20 minutes.
4. Rinse with clean water and remove excess puddles.
surfacePrep: Substrate must be porous, dry, and free of paint or curing compounds.
materialPrep: Ready to use straight from carboy.

title: SURFIX PE
subtitle: Penetrating Epoxy Base Densifier
desc: Two-component epoxy coating specially formulated for concrete sealer applications. Low-viscous formulation seeps deeply into concrete to stop heavy dusting.
highlight: Deep-Penetrating Epoxy Barrier Against Water & Heavy Dusting

techData.dryTime: Pot life: 30 mins • Tack-free: 4 hrs • Full cure: 7 days
techData.uses: High-traffic industrial floors, factory slabs, mechanical rooms with heavy concrete dusting, and priming prior to epoxy toppings.

features:
• Deep penetrative matrix anchors weak or degraded concrete surfaces
• Creates an impermeable barrier against water, oil, and chemical intrusion
• High chemical and physical strength halts surface deterioration
• Excellent primer for seamless epoxy coatings
appSchedule:
1. Mix Part A and Part B in correct proportions for 3 minutes.
2. Pour onto floor and spread evenly with roller or squeegee.
3. Allow 4-6 hours drying before recoating.
surfacePrep: Mechanically prepare concrete surface via grinding or shot-blasting to CSP 2-3.
materialPrep: Mix Part A and Part B thoroughly with slow-speed mechanical drill.

title: SURFIX FSE
subtitle: Fast-Setting Epoxy Bonding Agent for Concrete Piles
desc: Three-component, 30-minute fast-setting epoxy resin formulation with high chemical and physical strength designed primarily for bonding concrete piles.
highlight: 30-Minute Fast-Setting Epoxy Formulation for Concrete Piles

techData.dryTime: Pot life: 15-20 mins • Set time: 30 mins • Cure: 24 hrs
techData.applicationMethod: Trowel or pouring into pile joinery
techData.uses: Structural splicing of precast concrete driven piles, precast bridge segment joints, and rapid structural machinery repairs.

features:
• Ultra-fast 30-minute setting time minimizes crane standby costs
• High early compressive and flexural strength exceeds parent concrete
• Exceptional bonding to precast concrete pile heads
• 100% solids formulation with zero shrinkage
appSchedule:
1. Blend Part A and Part B, then incorporate Part C filler aggregate.
2. Trowel mortar onto precast pile top joint.
3. Lower subsequent pile segment into place within 15 minutes.
surfacePrep: Scrabble pile head to expose aggregate; clean and remove all dust and water.
materialPrep: Mix mechanical forced-action mixer or paddle drill.

title: SURFIX MB WHITE
subtitle: Solvent-Free Moisture Barrier Epoxy-Based Primer
desc: Two-component 100% solid epoxy specially formulated as a high-strength primer for use in priming concrete surfaces and steel prior to resin coatings.
highlight: Solvent-Free Moisture Barrier Epoxy Primer for Ground Level Floors

techData.dryTime: Pot life: 30 mins • Recoat: 6-8 hrs • Full cure: 7 days
techData.uses: Ground-level slabs with high moisture vapor emission, basements, commercial kitchens, and primers for epoxy floor systems.

features:
• Suppresses moisture vapor transmission up to 25 lbs / 1,000 sq ft / 24 hrs
• 100% solids: zero VOC, odorless, and solvent-free
• Outstanding adhesion to damp and green concrete slabs
• Prevents osmotic blistering in polyurethane and epoxy topcoats
appSchedule:
1. Verify slab moisture content.
2. Mix Part A and Part B thoroughly for 3 minutes.
3. Spread with notched squeegee and back-roll evenly.
4. Apply floor topping within 6-24 hours.
surfacePrep: Shot blast or diamond grind concrete to CSP 3. Vacuum thoroughly.
materialPrep: Mix full kits using slow-speed mechanical drill.

title: SURFIX WB
subtitle: Water-Based Epoxy Primer for Concrete & Elevated Areas
desc: Two-component water-based epoxy multifunctional primer that seals new and old concrete surfaces to prevent outgassing and air bubbles.
highlight: Water-Based Epoxy Primer to Prevent Outgassing & Air Bubbles

techData.dryTime: Touch dry: 2 hrs • Recoat: 4-6 hrs • Traffic: 24 hrs
techData.thinning: Clean water (max 5% if required on dry slabs)
techData.uses: Elevated floor slabs, precast concrete walls, screeds, balconies, and priming under polyurethane or epoxy coats.

features:
• Water-based formulation: non-flammable and low odor
• Seals surface micro-pinholes to eliminate bubble formation in topcoats
• Excellent bond to dry and slightly damp concrete substrates
• Easy clean-up with clean water
appSchedule:
1. Mix Part A and Part B at 3:1 ratio by weight.
2. Apply evenly using roller to saturate concrete pores.
3. Allow 4-6 hours drying before applying intermediate coat.
surfacePrep: Remove all curing agents, waxes, and loose laitance.
materialPrep: Mix mechanically for 3 minutes until smooth emulsion is achieved.

title: SURFIX SCA
subtitle: Horizontal & Vertical Scratch Coat for Smooth Surfaces
desc: 1K acrylic rendering bonding agent containing graded aggregates to improve mechanical adhesion on substrates especially on smooth surfaces.
highlight: 1K Acrylic Scratch Coat with Aggregates for Smooth Concrete & Tiles

techData.vehicle: Modified Acrylic Copolymer with Graded Silica Aggregates
techData.dryTime: Drying: 1-2 hrs • Ready for plaster/screed: 2-4 hrs
techData.thinning: Ready to use. Do not dilute
techData.uses: Smooth off-form concrete, shear walls, existing glazed tiles, precast panels prior to plastering or tile adhesive.

features:
• Creates rough mechanical texture on glassy smooth concrete surfaces
• Single component: ready to use straight from container
• Eliminates need for acid etching, chipping, or bush hammering
• Superior bond strength prevents debonding of heavy wall renders
appSchedule:
1. Stir container thoroughly to disperse silica aggregates.
2. Roll onto substrate in a single continuous coat.
3. Allow 2-4 hours to cure into a rigid textured key.
4. Apply cement plaster or mortar.
surfacePrep: Ensure substrate is clean, dust-free, and degreased.
materialPrep: Stir thoroughly before and during application.

title: CONFIX CONCRETE EPOXY HV
subtitle: High-Viscous Epoxy for Structural Crack Repairs
desc: High-viscosity epoxy adhesive designed for vertical application between old to new concrete, which sets permanently upon curing.
highlight: High-Viscous Structural Epoxy Adhesive for Vertical Joints & Cracks
dryTime: Pot life: 30 mins • Full cure: 7 days

techData.dryTime: Pot life: 30 mins • Initial set: 4-6 hrs • Full cure: 7 days
techData.packaging: Available in 7-Liter gallon set and quart set
techData.uses: Structural bonding of new concrete to old concrete, vertical columns, shear walls, structural crack sealing, and anchoring.

features:
• Non-sag consistency holds firmly on vertical and overhead surfaces
• Tensile and shear bond strength exceeds concrete tensile strength
• 100% solids, zero shrinkage, and water-resistant bond line
• ASTM C881 Type I, II, IV, V Grade 3 compliance
appSchedule:
1. Mix Part A and Part B 1:1 by volume for 3 minutes.
2. Apply with notched trowel to prepared substrate.
3. Place fresh concrete while Confix HV is still tacky (within 90 mins).
surfacePrep: Concrete must be structurally sound, dry, and free of oil and loose laitance.
materialPrep: Mix equal parts of A and B until uniform grey streak-free color.

title: CONFIX ANCHOR
subtitle: Chemical Anchor Structural Epoxy
desc: Structural epoxy adhesive designed specifically for high-load fastening of rebars, pipe hangers, threaded rods, and anchor bolts into concrete.
highlight: For Fastening Rebars, Pipe Hangars, Threaded Rods & Anchor Bolts
coverage: Calculated based on hole diameter and embedment depth

techData.dryTime: Gel: 10-15 mins • Curing: 4-6 hrs @ 30°C
techData.applicationMethod: Dual cartridge gun with static mixer or manual injection
techData.uses: Post-installed rebar connections, dowel bars, starter bars, heavy machinery anchoring, structural steel column baseplates.

features:
• High load-bearing capacity in cracked and uncracked concrete
• Styrene-free, low odor, suitable for indoor and confined spaces
• Moisture-insensitive: cures in damp or diamond-cored holes
• Zero shrinkage provides 100% load transfer to concrete foundation
appSchedule:
1. Drill hole to required diameter and depth.
2. Clean hole thoroughly: brush 3x, blow with air 3x.
3. Inject Confix Anchor from bottom of hole 2/3 full.
4. Insert rebar with twisting motion. Allow 6 hours cure.
surfacePrep: Drill hole must be blown completely clean of concrete dust and standing water.
materialPrep: Static mixing nozzle ensures automated 1:1 mixing.

title: SOLIDCURE
subtitle: Non-Shrink Cement-Based High-Strength Grout
desc: Non-shrink, cement-based, high-strength developing grout specially formulated for use in critical grouting operations and concrete spalling repair.
highlight: For Critical Grouting Operation & Honeycomb Repair
coverage: Flowable at 4.0-4.5 L water: 13.5 L grout

techData.vehicle: Pre-Blended Hydraulic Cement with Expansive Agents & Graded Silica
techData.applicationMethod: Gravity pour with headbox or pump
techData.thinning: 4.0 – 4.5 liters clean water per 25 kg bag
techData.uses: Machinery baseplates, crane rails, precast column shoes, bridge bearing pads, tie-rod holes, and structural honeycomb repairs.

features:
• Controlled positive expansion compensates for plastic and drying shrinkage
• High ultimate compressive strength exceeds 8,000 psi (55 MPa)

appSchedule:
1. Build rigid, water-tight formwork with headbox.
2. Pre-soak concrete foundation for 24 hours (SSD condition).
3. Pour continuously from one side to prevent air entrapment.
4. Wet cure for at least 7 days.
surfacePrep: Foundation concrete must be chipped to sound aggregate and free of oil.
materialPrep: Mix 25 kg bag with 4.0-4.5 L water in mechanical mixer for 3-5 minutes.

title: CONFIX CONCRETE EPOXY HV
subtitle: Vertical & Overhead Spalled Concrete Repair Bonding Agent
desc: High-viscous epoxy adhesive engineered for vertical and overhead spalled concrete repair work, ensuring monolithic bond between old concrete and mortar.

techData.dryTime: Pot life: 30 mins • Initial: 4 hrs • Full cure: 7 days
techData.uses: Spall repairs on beams, columns, soffits, bridge decks, and concrete balconies.

features:
• Zero-sag formulation clings to overhead and vertical surfaces without dripping
• High mechanical tensile bond secures repair mortars permanently
• Protects reinforcing rebar from moisture and corrosion
• Tolerates application in tropical ambient temperatures
appSchedule:
1. Chip around corroded rebar to minimum 20mm clearance.
2. Clean rebar to bright steel and coat with Confix HV.
3. Apply Confix HV over concrete contact face.
4. Trowel repair mortar wet-on-wet into cavity.
surfacePrep: Saw cut repair boundary square to 10mm depth. Concrete must be clean and dry.
materialPrep: Mix Part A and Part B thoroughly for 3 minutes.

title: SURFIX HARDCRETE FIX
subtitle: Polymer Bonding Agent for Mortars & Screeds
desc: Polymer-based bonding agent and adhesion enhancer for cementitious systems like floor toppings, renders, and repair mortars.

techData.dryTime: Tack: 30-45 mins • Setting: 2-3 hrs

features:

• Reduces water permeability and mortar shrinkage
• Non-toxic, zero VOC, and water-based

1. Prepare bonding slurry: 1 part Hardcrete Fix + 1 part water + 2 parts Portland cement.
2. Brush slurry vigorously into pre-dampened concrete.
3. Place new mortar immediately while slurry is wet.
surfacePrep: Substrate must be sound, clean, and saturated surface dry (SSD).
materialPrep: Shake container well before dispensing.

title: HARDCRETE 303
subtitle: Skim-Smoothing Ultra-Paste Compound

1. Mix Hardcrete 303 paste with Portland cement (1:1 by weight) with paddle drill.
2. Trowel firmly into concrete imperfections.
3. Smooth flush with adjacent concrete.
4. Allow 24 hours cure before painting.
surfacePrep: Concrete must be clean, sound, and free of release agents.
materialPrep: Blend thoroughly until uniform streak-free paste is obtained.

title: CONFIX EC
subtitle: 3-Part Cement and Epoxy Combination Mortar

1. Prime concrete with epoxy primer.
2. Mix Part A and Part B, then add Part C powder.
3. Pour and spread with pin rake.
4. Roll with spiked roller immediately to release air bubbles.
surfacePrep: Concrete must be mechanically pre-treated to CSP 3.
materialPrep: Mix full kit using forced action pan mixer.

title: CURE SIL WB
subtitle: Wax-Based Concrete Curing Compound

3. Wax film degrades naturally under traffic and UV exposure.

materialPrep: Stir well before spraying.

materialPrep: Stir before use.

title: SURFIX CEMENT GRIP

2. Roll Surfix Cement Grip evenly over the surface.
3. Pour self-leveling mortar while surface is tacky.
surfacePrep: Substrate must be dust-free, oil-free, and sound.
materialPrep: Stir lightly before dispensing.

4. Compact thoroughly, screed level, and broom finish.

title: CONFIX CARBON FIBER FABRIC EPOXY
subtitle: Wet Lay-Up Structural Retrofit Epoxy

title: CONFIX CARBON FIBER PLATE EPOXY
subtitle: Thixotropic Carbon Fiber Plate Adhesive

title: READYCRETE UW 4K
subtitle: Underwater Pre-Packed Ready-Mix Concrete

1. Mix Readycrete UW 4K with specified water ratio in paddle mixer.
2. Discharge through submerged tremie pipe keeping pipe tip immersed in fresh concrete.
3. Allow concrete to displace water naturally.

title: CURE FORM 300S
subtitle: Chemical Release Agent for Formworks
desc: Low-viscosity release agent based on specially formulated mineral oils providing clean, rapid release of concrete from timber, steel, and aluminum forms.
highlight: Chemical Release Agent for Formworks (Stain-Free Fair-Faced Concrete)
dryTime: Dries to oil barrier film immediately

techData.vehicle: Specially Formulated Mineral Oil Chemical Release Blend
techData.coverage: 20 – 60 m² per liter depending on form porosity
techData.dryTime: Immediate chemical release action
techData.applicationMethod: Low pressure spray, roller, or brush
techData.thinning: Ready to use. Do not dilute
techData.uses: Timber formwork, plywood shutters, steel molds, aluminum forms, and plastic casting liners.

features:
• Chemical reaction produces water-insoluble metallic soap barrier for effortless form stripping
• Extends formwork life and eliminates mechanical chipping damage
• Leaves concrete surface stain-free, minimizing blowholes and surface blemishes
• Economical high coverage up to 60 m² per liter
appSchedule:
1. Clean formwork face of hardened concrete residues.
2. Spray Cure Form 300S in a thin, uniform mist.
3. Wipe away any puddles with a sponge or rag.
4. Pour concrete as normal.
surfacePrep: Formwork must be clean and dry prior to spraying.
materialPrep: Single component, ready to use directly from container.

title: CONCRETE PATCH H
subtitle: Rapid Setting Repair Mortar for Pavements and Floors
desc: Cementitious pre-packed repair mortar with shrinkage compensation properties, developing 2,500 psi in 3 hours and 6,500 psi at 28 days.
highlight: Rapid Setting Mortar for Pavement and Floors (2,500 psi in 3 hrs)
coverage: Yields 16 liters (0.016 m³) with 4.5 L water
dryTime: 3 hrs: 2,500 psi • 1 day: 4,000 psi • 28 days: 6,500 psi

techData.vehicle: Rapid-Hardening Hydraulic Cement with Shrinkage Compensators
techData.dryTime: Initial set: 20-30 mins • 3-hr: 2,500 psi • 28-day: 6,500 psi
techData.thinning: 4.0 – 4.5 liters clean water per 25 kg bag
techData.uses: High-traffic road repairs, highway toll plazas, airport taxiway repairs, factory floors, loading docks, and freezer rooms.

features:
• Ultra-fast traffic return: opens to vehicle wheel traffic in as fast as 3 hours
• Non-shrink formulation with positive expansion prevents edge cracking
• High final compressive strength exceeds 6,500 psi (45 MPa)
• Excellent freeze-thaw and abrasion resistance
appSchedule:
1. Measure 4.0-4.5 L clean water and pour into mixer.
2. Add Concrete Patch H and mix for 2-3 minutes.
3. Place into patch cavity and screed level.
4. Lightly mist or apply curing membrane.
surfacePrep: Saw cut perimeter vertically to 10mm depth. Pre-soak surface with water (SSD).
materialPrep: Mix with clean water only. Do not add sand or cement.

title: HARDCRETE NM
subtitle: Non-Metallic Surface Hardener
desc: Pre-mixed non-metallic ready-to-use surface hardener applied as dry shake over freshly floated concrete to provide a hard-wearing monolithic floor.
highlight: Non-Metallic Dry Shake Surface Hardener for Monolithic Floors
dryTime: Initial set with slab • Full: 28 days

techData.vehicle: Graded Non-Metallic Quartz & Mineral Aggregates with Cement & Additives
techData.dryTime: Troweled into fresh concrete slab
techData.applicationMethod: Dry shake broadcast and power trowel finishing
techData.thinning: Do not add water. Broadcast dry
techData.uses: Warehouses, industrial manufacturing plants, logistics centers, aircraft hangars, parking garages, and hypermarkets.

features:
• Quadruples concrete floor surface abrasion resistance
• Non-metallic quartz aggregates: 100% rust-free in wet environments
• High density resists oil and grease penetration
• Integrated monolithically with concrete slab: cannot delaminate
appSchedule:
1. Wait for bleed water on fresh concrete to evaporate and bull float.
2. Broadcast 2/3 of Hardcrete NM evenly; allow to absorb moisture.
3. Power float, then broadcast remaining 1/3 at right angles.
4. Power trowel to burnished smooth finish.
surfacePrep: Apply directly onto freshly placed, screeded, and floated concrete slab.
materialPrep: Ready to use dry shake powder straight from bag.

title: LEVEL UP 403 / 410
subtitle: Self-Leveling Underlayment Mortar
desc: Ready-to-mix self-leveling underlayment mortar used for leveling, smoothening, and repairing interior floors before laying vinyl, tiles, or coatings.
highlight: Self-Leveling Compound 3-10mm Thickness at 4,000 psi

techData.dryTime: Walkable: 4 hrs • Resilient floor overlay: 24 hrs
techData.applicationMethod: Pin rake, squeegee, and spiked roller
techData.thinning: 5.5 – 6.0 L clean water per 25 kg bag
techData.uses: Leveling uneven concrete slabs in residential buildings, hotels, hospitals, and offices prior to vinyl, carpet, or parquet.

features:
• Outstanding flowability creates perfectly level floors without troweling
• Rapid setting: light foot traffic in 4 hours, flooring installation in 24 hours
• High compressive strength: 4,000 psi at 28 days
• Smooth, flat surface suppresses telegraphing of imperfections through vinyl
appSchedule:
1. Prime concrete with Surfix Cement Grip and allow to tack.
2. Mix Level Up with clean water for 2-3 minutes with paddle drill.
3. Pour onto slab, gauge with pin rake, and roll immediately with spiked roller.
surfacePrep: Concrete must be clean, structurally sound, and primed with Surfix Cement Grip.
materialPrep: Mix with clean water using slow-speed paddle drill.

title: BENSOIL
subtitle: Construction Sodium Bentonite
desc: Selectively mined high-montmorillonite sodium bentonite produced under controlled conditions for slurry trenches, drilling fluids, and waterproofing barriers.
highlight: High-Montmorillonite Bentonite for Diaphragm Walls & Bored Piling
dryTime: Forms thixotropic gel instantly in water

techData.dryTime: Hydrates instantly into dense thixotropic gel
techData.uses: Diaphragm walls, bored piling, pipe jacking, micro-tunneling lubricants, cutoff walls, and environmental pond liners.

features:
• High swelling capacity forms impermeable hydraulic barrier
• Rapid hydration yields high-viscosity thixotropic slurry
• Stabilizes borehole walls and prevents excavation collapse in soft soils
• Natural, chemically inert, and environmentally safe
appSchedule:
1. Add Bensoil slowly to water in high-shear mixer at 30-50 kg/m³.
2. Agitate for 10-15 minutes until fully hydrated.
3. Pump into excavation trench to support soil walls during excavation.
surfacePrep: Ensure mixing water is clean and fresh (low calcium and hardness).
materialPrep: Mix in high-shear colloidal mixer.
